messages:
maria: heads up — I spun up cascade-embed-v2 int6 on staging. quick eval shows recall@10 down ~6% for short queries (<8 tokens). posting eval summary.

kai: thanks — what's the baseline and batch settings?

maria: baseline = flagship-embed-v1 fp16; staging switch was int6-perchannel + pooling=cls. batch_size=64. sample: 2k short queries from prod holdout.

jordan: @maria can you paste the eval snippet? also which index (hnsw/pq)?

maria: eval snippet:
```
model: cascade-embed-v2-int6
holdout: short-query-2k
recall@1: 0.62
recall@5: 0.79
recall@10: 0.74
baseline_recall@10: 0.80
```
index: hnsw (ef=128)

rachel: that recall@1 is pretty low too. did you change whitening / length-norm? pooling=cls may be worse for very short queries.

maria: tried avg pooling earlier — recall@10 0.78, recall@1 0.64. still below baseline.

kai: can we try L2-normalize before indexing and run with ef=256 for HNSW to rule out index-induced recall loss? also try batch_size=128 to check batching effects.

ops-bot: deploy note: cascade-embed-v2-int6 rolled to staging at 2026-03-20T14:05Z by maria

maria: will run two runs (L2+ef256 and avg-pool sweep) and post results in ~45m. adding eval-bot to re-run benchmark.

eval-bot: scheduled run id=run-2321 params=[l2norm:true,ef:256,batch:128,pooling:cls] ETA ~30m

jordan: triage plan: 1) test L2+ef256 2) compare avg vs cls pooling across short/long query buckets 3) if gap persists, run per-channel quantization audit + dequant sim.

rachel: also double-check kNN ground-truth construction for short queries — annotation ambiguity can bias recall@1.

maria: thanks all. I'll upload the run logs and csv once ready :thumbsup:
